text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper's primary focus is not LULC prediction. It is a multi-model economic analysis of the forest sector under socioeconomic scenarios (SSPs). While it projects changes in national forest *area* for New Zealand, this is an output of an economic partial equilibrium model (NZFARM) driven by exogenous price signals and policy assumptions. The core research is on estimating economic and environmental (carbon, nutrients) impacts, not on spatially predicting LULC patterns. The modeling lacks the spatial explicitness and quantitative accuracy metrics central to LULC prediction studies. It uses predefined scenarios to project aggregate land-use change, not to simulate or validate the spatial allocation of LULC classes.)
